entries.title: Shadow of Rome

emulation.notes: PCSX2 is the practical preservation route for high-resolution capture from an owned PS2 copy.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 assets and presentation with emulator-side resolution and filtering improvements.

primary.why: Shadow of Rome is a PlayStation 2-only Capcom release with no sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease, so the original PS2 version is the complete canonical release.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PlayStation 2 copy on original hardware, or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for cleaner output and emulator-side scaling.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console release; best sourced route because no later official version was identified.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced commercial platform for the game, preserving the full original release.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate release with higher fidelity or exclusive content was identified.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease was identified. The cancelled sequel is unrelated to a playable version of Shadow of Rome.
